extracted.intended_audience: DOE/NNSA staff, DOE site contractors and operators of defense nuclear facilities, DNFSB, and other stakeholders concerned with onsite transportation safety and safety-basis documents
extracted.subtask_description: Federal Register notice recording DOE's formal acceptance of DNFSB Recommendation 2023-1 and DOE commitments to revise transportation safety documents, methods, oversight, and directives governing onsite transportation of radioactive materials at defense nuclear facilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Revise LANL Transportation Safety Document (TSD) / DSA
rubrics_metrics.description: Revise the LANL TSD to address the safety concerns identified in this Recommendation and to comply with a revised safe harbor methodology per sub-Recommendation 2.a.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: DOE/NNSA Los Alamos Field Office approved a revised LANL TSD DSA with conditions of approval requiring LANL to address additional comments in 2023 and 2024 annual updates; once DOE completes Recommendation 2.a, LANL will revise their DSA following the new methodology.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain compensatory safety measures until revised DSA implemented
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure compensatory safety measures remain in place until implementation of the LANL TSD revised per Sub-Recommendation 1.a.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: DOE elevated compensatory safety measures to Technical Safety Requirements (TSRs) so the controls cannot be changed without DOE approval; DOE commits to ensuring the approved safety basis maintains those elevated controls until LANL re-writes the DSA and TSRs following a revised methodology.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rewrite DOE safe harbors for onsite transportation (Order/Guide)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rewrite DOE safe harbors for onsite transportation (DOE Order 460.1D and DOE Guide 460.1-1) to provide requirements and guidance ensuring TSDs comply with applicable safety-basis requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rewritten safe harbors must ensure TSDs comply with all applicable 10 CFR 830 safety basis requirements including requirements related to accident evaluation and hazard controls; DOE will revise the DSA methodology for onsite transfers to ensure compliance with 10 CFR part 830, subpart B, Safety Basis Requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include robust evaluation criteria in safe harbors to demonstrate effectiveness
rubrics_metrics.description: Include robust evaluation criteria to ensure TSDs demonstrate that safety controls are effective at reducing risk.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Safe harbor revisions should include clear evaluation metrics and criteria so reviewers can determine whether TSD safety controls demonstrably reduce risk; this ties into how DSAs/TSRs will be reviewed and approved.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide implementation guidance for restricting public access and controlling onsite traffic
rubrics_metrics.description: Include implementation guidance in safe harbors for restricting public access to transportation routes, and controlling onsite traffic, during onsite transportation of radioactive materials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance should cover practical measures to restrict access and manage onsite traffic during radioactive material movements to reduce public and worker exposure and risk during transfers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Revise DOE-STD-1104 to incorporate TSD review/approval requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Change DOE Standard 1104, Review and Approval of Nuclear Facility Safety Basis and Safety Design Basis Documents, to incorporate requirements and guidance for DOE review and approval of TSDs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Once the methodology in Sub-Recommendation 2.a is complete, DOE will revise DOE-STD-1104 as appropriate for reviewing and approving DSAs and TSRs for onsite transfers, ensuring the standard explicitly addresses TSDs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conduct extent-of-condition review of TSDs/DSAs/TSRs across DOE defense sites
rubrics_metrics.description: Conduct an extent of condition review of TSDs for DOE sites with defense nuclear facilities to identify any near-term actions necessary to ensure safety until the safe harbors are revised and implemented.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: DOE will compile extent-of-condition work already completed and will review DSAs and TSRs for onsite transfers at remaining DOE sites to determine near-term actions; the review will evaluate variation between DSAs/TSRs to understand how the current methodology is being implemented and identify potential issues that could inform actions for Sub-Recommendation 2.a.

rubrics_metrics.name: Perform independent causal analysis of safety issues and DOE oversight effectiveness
rubrics_metrics.description: Perform an independent causal analysis for the safety issues identified, including the effectiveness of DOE oversight of contractor TSDs, DOE's management of onsite transportation directives, and DOE's evaluation of and actions in response to prior Board correspondence on onsite transportation safety.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify and implement corrective actions based on causal analysis results to preclude recurrence of the safety issues; DOE notes the need for greater flexibility in identifying corrective actions (particularly Sub-Recommendation 3.a) and will implement applicable corrective actions pending extent-of-condition review outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure revised DSA methodology enforces compliance with 10 CFR part 830, subpart B
rubrics_metrics.description: Revise the DSA methodology for onsite transfers to ensure compliance with 10 CFR part 830, subpart B, Safety Basis Requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Methodology changes are intended to align onsite transfer DSAs with federal safety-basis regulations, including accident evaluation and hazard control requirements; this underpins revisions to safe harbors, DOE-STD-1104, and site-level DSAs/TSRs.
